access_links.note: Verified link relocation on 2026-10-09. Official data.europa.eu and Torino GeoNetwork metadata identify the homogeneous zones of the Metropolitan City of Turin and describe the associated WFS service. Current WFS capabilities list feature type ms:Zone_omogenee titled Zone_omogenee. The old saved base URL has no WFS request parameters and returns 404. The capabilities route works and lists the expected feature type, but no GetFeature request was made.

dedupe_keys.name: zone omogenee citta metropolitana di torino

description: ZONE OMOGENEE CITTÀ METROPOLITANA DI TORINO is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opengis.csi.it. Suddivisione territoriale della Città metropolitana di Torino in 11 zone omogenee ai sensi dell’art.27 dello Statuto della Città Metropolitana di Torino approvato dalla Conferenza Metropolitana il 14/04/2015.Costituiscono un'articolazione operativa della Conferenza metropolitana per le finalità definite dallo Statuto della Città Metropolitana di Torino, e sono disciplinate da apposito regolamento.Quattro zone sono nell’area metropolitana di Torino ... Coverage: IT. Its keywords include RNDT, zone, omogenee, aggregazioni, urbane, opendata. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
